title: The readouts that fade away
summary: The messages that appear and leave the screen in R.E.P.O. are one design repeated: each has a line of text, a position to show at and a position to hide at, a timer before it goes, and a curve it shrinks along, and the same shape carries the goal, the haul, an item's name, a shop cost and a shop increase.
body: The messages that appear and leave are not written one at a time. They share a base with a line of text, a transform for that text, a position to show at and a position to hide at, which is why the shop's notices behave alike.
Each waits before it goes. There is a default hide timer and a flag for whether the message is hidden, so a notice sits on screen for a moment rather than for as long as it takes to be read.

They leave by shrinking. There is an animation curve for the shrink and an event raised when it finishes, so a message can be drawn inwards rather than simply switched off, and something can be told when it has gone.
They can animate as a whole. There is a flag for animating the entire object rather than only its text, which is why some notices move as a panel and others only as words.
They can also be protected. A flag keeps a message from being disabled, so a notice that matters can be held rather than cleared with the rest.

The same shape does several jobs. The goal readout, the haul readout, the item information line and its extra line, and the shop cost and shop increase readouts all use it, which is why they appear, wait and shrink in the same way.
One of them counts. The shop cost readout carries an animated value, so a number can be seen climbing rather than appearing at its final figure.

Another keeps its own timer. The item information line carries a message timer of its own alongside the shared hide timer, so it can be paced differently from the others without a new design being written.
What this entry does not tell you: how long a message stays, how far it shrinks, or what any of them says. We have not verified those numbers, so we do not print them.

facts.claim: The readouts share a base with a text, a transform, a show position and a hide position.
facts.evidence: identifiers: SemiUI, uiText, textRectTransform, showPosition, hidePosition

facts.claim: Each has a default hide timer and a hidden flag.
They shrink on an animation curve and raise an event when the shrink completes.
They can animate the whole object rather than only the text.
They can be kept from being disabled.
The same shape is used for the goal, haul, item and extra item readouts and for the shop cost and shop increase readouts.
facts.evidence: identifiers: GoalUI, HaulUI, ItemInfoUI, ItemInfoExtraUI, ShopCostUI, ShopIncreaseUI

facts.claim: The shop cost readout carries an animated value.
The item information readout keeps a message timer of its own.
